findings.status: deferred — source-side: the English labels are 32/33 cells against the 29-cell budget, so the clip is pre-existing and locale-independent
findings.detail: Current 'Terminales de agente por conversación' is 37 cells against the renderer's 29-cell row-label budget (_LABEL_BUDGET = 34 - 2 - 2 - 1 = 29, settings_view.py:434). The row is a registry Setting (settings_io.py:4785-4788, key console.max_owner, section 'console') and section 'console' is always visible (team_bridge/availability.py:86-87 returns True for every name except BRIDGE_SECTION), so the row always renders. settings_view.py:4020 passes every row label through truncate_cells(setting.label, 29), which cannot wrap. Measured with the repository's own truncate_cells: 'Terminales de agente por con…'. Round 1 audited this namespace and did not measure this label.
findings.remediation: WITHDRAWN: 'Terminales de agente' (20 cells) should not be applied — it buys a clip-free label by deleting the per-conversation scope the setting exists to express, a loss the English does not make. Source-side fix: shorten the English label to <=29 cells or raise _LABEL_BUDGET, then let Spanish follow that decision.

control.method: the same helper the renderer uses: local_operator.tui.widgets.tool_card.truncate_cells(x, 29)
control.finding: BOTH locales clip. The defect is source-side: the English label is 32 cells against a 29-cell budget. Spanish adds 5 cells, so it loses more of the tail, but it does not introduce the clip and a Spanish-only shortening would not remove it from the screen.
control.note_for_reader: The pushback quoted the English cut as 'Agent terminals per conver…'; the real helper yields 'Agent terminals per conversa…' (29 cells). Substance unchanged.

findings.reclassification_reason: Reclassified blocker -> minor in amendment A1 after running the same-code control the audit should have run first. A translator cannot be held to a budget the source itself violates; the fix belongs in the source.

findings.status: deferred — source-side: the English labels are 32/33 cells against the 29-cell budget, so the clip is pre-existing and locale-independent
findings.detail: Current 'Ranuras de terminales de usuario' is 32 cells against the same 29-cell budget; it renders as 'Ranuras de terminales de usu…'. The row is settings_io.py:4796-4799 (key console.user_reserved, section 'console'), so it clips on the same always-visible section. Round 1 raised this key as a nit about expansion percentage, under the mistaken premise that no budget applied: its own proposed replacement, 'Ranuras reservadas para el usuario', is 32 cells and would clip identically. The clip is now measured, not inferred.
findings.remediation: WITHDRAWN: 'Ranuras de usuario' (18 cells) should not be applied — it drops 'terminales', which is the object the row governs. Source-side fix only: shorten the English label to <=29 cells or raise _LABEL_BUDGET.

control.method: the same helper the renderer uses: local_operator.tui.widgets.tool_card.truncate_cells(x, 29)
control.finding: BOTH locales clip, and Spanish is ONE CELL SHORTER than English (32 vs 33). Spanish is strictly no worse than the source: there is no locale regression here at all, only a pre-existing source-side budget breach.

findings.reclassification_reason: Reclassified blocker -> minor in amendment A1. The control shows Spanish is shorter than the English it translates, so this could never have been a Spanish defect.

findings.detail: English 'the global live allowance' becomes 'la cuota global de terminales activas'. 'cuota' is this locale's rendering of 'quota' elsewhere in the same wave (wire.settings.account_policy.headroom.description, 'la cuota restante en caché'), so English's allowance/quota distinction collapses onto one Spanish word. Meaning is recoverable from context.
findings.remediation: 'el cupo global de terminales activas' - 'cupo' is the capacity sense and leaves 'cuota' to quota.

findings.detail: 'El historial completado no consume ranuras de proceso' renders 'Completed history does not consume process slots'. It is understandable but 'historial completado' reads as a completed history rather than a history of completed terminals; a native phrasing names what was completed.
findings.remediation: 'El historial de terminales completadas no consume ranuras de proceso' - same facts, the completed thing named.

The translator therefore had no budget signal for the two labels that clip (C01, C02). This is a sidecar gap that will produce the same defect in every future locale.

fact_1_label_budget.claim: every settings row label is rendered as truncate_cells(label, 29)
fact_1_label_budget.evidence: settings_view.py:4020 truncate_cells(setting.label, _LABEL_BUDGET); settings_view.py:434 _LABEL_BUDGET = _VALUE_COLUMN(34) - _ROW_INDENT(2) - _MARKER_WIDTH(2) - 1 = 29; truncate_cells cannot wrap (tool_card.py:728-750).
fact_1_label_budget.consequence: Any label over 29 cells is painted cut with a visible ellipsis. Applies to the console rows (settings_io.py:4774-4799, section 'console', always visible) and to the hub and failover rows, not only to the two namespaces the briefing named.

fact_2_wrap_rung.claim_as_briefed: when no rung fits, _wrap_cells(help_text, width, max_lines=2) renders the help across two rows, so the two hub_defaults help strings are acceptable with a narrow-width limit
fact_2_wrap_rung.evidence: The wrap rung is a None entry in the shed ladder and is created only in the bridge_row branches (settings_view.py:4881 for the no-clause case, 4873 region for the clause case). bridge_row is set at settings_view.py:4767 from section == team_bridge.BRIDGE_SECTION, and BRIDGE_SECTION is the literal 'team_bridge' (team_bridge/availability.py:33). The hub rows are section 'hub' (settings_io.py:5120). No None rung exists for them, so _wrap_cells at 4910 is never reached and the ladder's last rung, settings_view.py:4937, applies: truncate_cells(rendered.plain, width) - a marked cut, not a wrap. _wrap_cells' own docstring scopes it to 'the agent-messages explanation only'.
fact_2_wrap_rung.measured: _detail_width() is max(total-2, 24) (settings_view.py:5203), i.e. 98 cells at 100 columns and 78 at 80. agents.help is 113 cells -> truncated at both sizes, whole only from 115 columns. teams.help is 94 -> whole at 100 columns once the key path sheds, truncated at 80.
fact_2_wrap_rung.consequence: The briefing's premise is wrong for this surface; round 1 had it right. agents.help is a real defect (C03 major), not an accepted narrow-width limit. teams.help is a narrow-width limit only (C04 minor).
